executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under heavy pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest segments. New capacity and improved yields can relieve the market but will only reach buyers with a time lag. For purchasers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
